primitives.name: Human-Auditable Condition-Action Betting Rules
primitives.verbatim_quote: **SHARP (2605.06822, ledger 2090)** — human-auditable condition-action betting rules evolved by an attribution agent with a walk-forward gate.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C: condition set, A: action set, T: time index, W: walk-forward window
primitives.assumptions: Actions are binary, conditions are discrete, temporal evolution is Markovian within W.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C ∩ A ≠ ∅, transition probabilities collapse to deterministic mappings.

layer2.mapping: SHARP maps to GSE's policy graph where each node represents a condition-action pair with reward-weighted transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Walk-forward validation accuracy and entropy of action selection

primitives.name: Symbolic Equation Distillation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **SymTorch (2602.21307, ledger 2162, ADOPT)** — drop-in PyTorch→PySR distillation (proven on GNNs, PINNs, LLMs): turns GSE's black-box neural components into ≤10-term auditable equations.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: f: neural function, g: symbolic approximation, θ: parameters, ε: error term
primitives.assumptions: Neural component f approximates g up to ε in L2 norm over domain D.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ||f - g|| > δ, symbolic form becomes invalid and retraining required.

layer2.mapping: SymTorch enables GSE's kernel abstraction by converting learned representations into interpretable symbolic forms.
layer2.telemetry: Number of terms in distilled equation and fidelity to original model output

primitives.name: Distribution-Free Coverage via Conformal Prediction
primitives.verbatim_quote: **SINDy with Conformal Prediction (2507.11739, ledger 2165, ADOPT)** — the only method found giving distribution-free coverage on discovered equations/coefficients; every published metric gets honest uncertainty intervals.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: E: equation set, Θ: coefficient vector, U: uncertainty interval, α: significance level
primitives.assumptions: Equations are linear in Θ, and U is constructed without distributional assumptions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When α → 0, U shrinks to point estimates; when α → 1, U expands to cover all plausible values.

layer2.mapping: SINDy+CP provides GSI with confidence bounds on discovered dynamics, enabling robust inference under model misspecification.
layer2.telemetry: Coverage rate of uncertainty intervals and width of prediction bands

reasoning_traces.think:
SHARP encodes a dual logic: it evolves condition-action pairs through attribution agents that evaluate causal impact, while enforcing a walk-forward gate to prevent overfitting. This dualism mirrors GSE’s need for both reactive and predictive state transitions. SymTorch bridges GSE’s opaque neural modules with symbolic equations, enabling formal reasoning about system behavior. Its distillation process ensures that complex models can be reduced to interpretable forms without loss of functional integrity. SINDy with Conformal Prediction offers a principled way to quantify uncertainty in discovered equations, aligning with GSI’s requirement for calibrated probabilistic inference. Together, these primitives form a triad of interpretability, causality, and calibration essential for autonomous sports intelligence systems.
